scope: Independent read-only peer review of exact AIMP Android 4.31.1747 official-v2 and static-v1 candidates. No control, count, candidate or device mutation.

qualification_review.eula_distribution_scope: Freeware original distribution files; no full application source grant in reviewed EULA
qualification_review.publisher_statement_scope: Historical statement that source would be opened only if the project closed; not by itself proof of every current source location
qualification_review.bounded_closed_source_conclusion: Eligible blackbox test-input candidate on current official binary, market and bounded source evidence; any later contrary full-source evidence requires reclassification

first_generation_failure: official-v1 fetched only the publisher page and has no RESULT.json or APK; its HTML check required escaped & but the saved page used literal & in the id=13 link. No v1 success or qualification is inherited. The original v2 VERIFY.json candidate_pass=false because it expected the abbreviated page version as the full manifest name; VERIFY-V2.json candidate_pass=true under the exact signed manifest version. Both receipts remain distinct.
target_sdk37_risk: Manifest targetSdk 37 exceeds the AOSP16 API36 baseline. This is an untested install/runtime compatibility risk, not an observed failure and not a host-static disqualifier.
proven: The exact publisher-hashed unmodified APK, signed package identity, bounded host archive/static inventory, and overseas market evidence support separate root review of three test-input layers.
not_proven: Root admission, device installation, App Bionic runtime, truly-cold Activity start, screen or interaction. No Play APK-byte/signature equivalence is claimed.
observed_wall: none for the v2 raw and static candidate; the retained v1 preflight and original v2 version comparison failures do not transfer as v2 failures
next_evidence: Root may separately admit raw, host static and exact blackbox test-input qualification. Runtime acceptance requires an authorized device and current-generation cold-start receipt; preserve targetSdk37 risk for that stage.
actions: Read-only local inspection plus direct reads of publisher, Google Play and publisher EULA/blog pages. No candidate replay, device, container, SSH, Bridge or push.
